purpose: Describe reusable Runtime Evidence capability families, canonical source files, freshness contracts, epistemic boundaries and bounded adapters without activating owner teaching or granting execution authority.

semantics.registryIsNotActivation: A capability being listed here means its evidence family/source boundary is known. It enters Runtime Reasoning Evidence only when a runtime-owner-activation unit explicitly requests that capability and its adapter validates fresh evidence.
semantics.sourceVerifiedIsNotSchemaBound: A source can be verified as canonical and live while its Runtime Evidence extraction adapter remains disabled until schema semantics are independently inspected.
semantics.economicFamiliesRemainDistinct: Rewards, Reference APR/Productivity, Embedded Yield and Realised Cash Flow are separate economic objects and must never be silently collapsed into one generic income metric.
semantics.degradation: Missing, stale, invalid, partial or semantically unsupported evidence degrades locally and is never fabricated as zero or carried forward as current.
semantics.ownerContextBoundary: Owner teaching supplies decision context. Current balances, yields, rewards, incidents and protocol facts require canonical evidence sources.

capabilities.label: Health Factor Monitoring
capabilities.scope: Current canonical supported lending positions only; zero-debt state remains healthFactor=null/not-applicable.

capabilities.label: Claimable Rewards Observation

source.note: Canonical production artifact verified in repository; file is large and Runtime Evidence field semantics must be independently bound before emission.

capabilities.scope: Claimable/accrued reward inventory only. Does not imply realised cash flow or embedded yield.

capabilities.label: Reference APR / Productivity Observation

freshness.rationale: Canonical Productivity cadence is weekly; freshness allowance is bounded above one week rather than borrowing the 30h risk-source rule.

capabilities.scope: Current normalized Reference APR/productive capacity. Unknown engines are excluded rather than treated as 0%. This is not historical realised cash flow.

capabilities.label: Realised Cash Flow Observation
capabilities.scope: Direct proven realised-income lanes only. Current Yield Basis adapter is intentionally incomplete for whole-company cash flow and historical USD may remain null by design.

capabilities.label: Embedded Yield Observation
capabilities.scope: Value accrued inside yield-bearing wrappers/vault shares; separate from claimable rewards and realised claims.
